$comment: The platform settings hub.json (read by bin/hubconf.py; template hub.example.json). bin/config-check validates it with minischema and also rejects unknown top-level keys (except explanation keys starting with _), so a misspelled key is never silently ignored. Adding a field keeps the version.

connect.description: docs/design/newcomer-path.md B5/B6: the folders the owner named as holding projects; connecting a folder from an agent session (the MCP server's connect_project) is allowed only strictly inside one of them or workspace_root

language.description: ui: what the platform shows the owner; content: what models and agents write (docs/design/i18n.md). Default en.

principal_id.description: Principal Handoff: the principal identifier (core R6), the same on every system that exchanges records with this deployment

legal_person.description: Principal Handoff: the principal is a legal person (settlements then name a representative)

party_id.description: Principal Handoff: the principal side's party identifier

owner_side.description: the principal side of Principal Handoff: assistant = the assistant in hub.json assistant (through its API); builtin = the platform's built-in minimal owner side (bin/owner.py). Absent: assistant if assistant.api is set, otherwise builtin

send_version.description: the Principal Handoff version of the records this deployment sends to the principal side (Acts and Decisions, every project; core §14 configures it per role, project and extension, and one principal side serves every project here). Records in 0.3, 0.4 and 0.5 are read whatever it says. Default 0.4; set 0.5 once the principal side confirms it accepts 0.5

librarian.description: docs/design/llm-providers.md step 4: which parts of the nightly librarian run as completion (the model returns an edit list, the platform checks and writes it) instead of the agent version. Per part: true = completion in charge, false = the agent version, absent = the agent version where this machine can run it, otherwise completion. The owner switches a part from the shadow report (bin/librarian-shadow-report.py)

handler.description: how a request nobody picks up is dispatched: agent = the runtime's agent handles it directly (needs the tool's permissions; only Claude Code for now); propose = any agent runs in a throwaway worktree, the platform adopts only the memory notes and sends the letters for it (bin/propose_apply.py). Default agent

mcp_presence_min.description: minutes a session using the mailbox only through the platform's MCP server counts as using its project after its last agenthub tool call (docs/design/mailbox-runtimes.md A3). Default 30

mcp_hold_max_min.description: while such a session uses the project, a request/question to it not yet delivered to any session is held at most this many minutes from the letter's time, then dispatched as usual. Default 120

service_sandbox_exempt.description: sandboxed projects whose own services and command jobs still run unsandboxed, temporarily, until they stop reading platform credentials themselves (bin/sandboxed-run, seatbelt.sandboxed). Only the owner adds to it; a project can't (hub.json is the platform's)

installed.description: every coding agent the user opens sessions with (docs/design/mailbox-runtimes.md A1): each gets its hooks, its rules-file block, and its sessions are asked about by their runtime. Default [runtime.default]; runtime.default stays the one the platform starts

bare_ids.description: the runtime whose session ids the bus keeps without a <runtime>: prefix (every other runtime's are written <runtime>:<id>). Default claude, the runtime of every id written before runtime.installed existed; it never follows runtime.default, so changing the default never reroutes an old id

acp.description: Agent Client Protocol agents (bin/runtime_acp.py header; docs/design/runtime-acp.md): agent names the entry of agents the acp runtime uses

llm.description: which LLM provider and model the judgment points use, and where the key is (bin/completion.py header; docs/design/llm-providers.md). No providers = judgment points go to runtime.default, models from the runtime's group table; points can be set on their own (the model of individual judgment points). How models are chosen lives only in llm.model_for / completion.resolve; semantic checks in completion.config_errors()
